scenario_title_zh: 绣花/印花/水洗工艺沟通

rounds.ai_message: Hello, this is Jack from Lily Embroidery House. You sent an inquiry for chest embroidery — what can I help you with?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 你好，我是 Lily 绣花厂的 Jack。你发了胸前绣花的询盘，请讲。
rounds.common_mistakes: 绣花询价要报尺寸、针数、件数。
rounds.tips_zh: 绣花报价三要素：尺寸（cm）、针数（stitches）、件数。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Jack. We need chest embroidery on 5,000 T-shirts. Logo is 8 cm wide, about 6,000 stitches. DST file is ready.

rounds.ai_message: Got it. For 8 cm wide, satin stitch is the best choice. We have 12-head machine for fast turnaround. What's your fabric — knit or woven?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。8 厘米宽最适合缎面绣。我们有 12 头机快速出货。面料是针织还是梭织？
rounds.common_mistakes: knit 与 woven 绣花底衬（backing）不同。
rounds.tips_zh: 针织布用 tear-away 衬；梭织布用 cut-away 衬。
rounds.user_response_example: 100% cotton single jersey, 180 GSM. Tear-away backing is fine.

rounds.ai_message: Tear-away backing on jersey is standard. About the thread — what color and material do you need — polyester, rayon, or metallic?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 汗布用易撕衬是标准。绣线——颜色和材质？涤纶、人丝，还是金属线？
rounds.common_mistakes: polyester 绣线色牢度好；rayon 光泽好但牢度差；metallic 易断。
rounds.tips_zh: polyester 绣线是主流；rayon 光泽好但水洗牢度差；metallic 用于点缀。
rounds.user_response_example: Polyester thread, Pantone 19-4052 navy. Metallic gold accent on the outline.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Digitizing fee is US$25 per design. For 5,000 pieces, embroidery cost is US$0.18 per piece with 6,000 stitches. Total US$925. Lead time 10 days for samples.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。打版费每图 25 美元。5,000 件绣花 6,000 针每件 0.18 美元，合计 925 美元。样衣 10 天。
rounds.common_mistakes: 打版费 refundable on bulk 是行业惯例，要主动确认。
rounds.tips_zh: 打版费 25-50 美元/图，大货冲抵是行业惯例。
rounds.user_response_example: Quote received. Digitizing fee refundable on bulk order, correct? 10 days lead time is fine.

rounds.ai_message: Yes, refundable on bulk. By the way, the T-shirts will be garment dyed and enzyme washed after embroidery. Will the embroidery survive the wash?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 对，大货可冲抵。另外 T 恤绣花后要做成衣染和酵素水洗。绣花能承受水洗吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明绣花与水洗兼容性
rounds.common_mistakes: polyester 绣线耐酵素水洗；rayon 不耐。
rounds.tips_zh: polyester 绣线耐 30 分钟酵素水洗；rayon 仅耐 10 分钟以内。
rounds.user_response_example: Polyester thread survives enzyme wash easily. We have washed similar designs at 60°C with no issues.

rounds.ai_message: Perfect. After embroidery, do you want the print on top — water-based or plastisol?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。绣花后还要加印花——水浆还是胶浆？
rounds.common_mistakes: 水浆柔软但牢度差；胶浆厚实但偏硬。
rounds.tips_zh: 水浆手感柔软，胶浆厚实有立体感；按风格选择。
rounds.user_response_example: Water-based ink for soft hand feel. Discharge print on the dark color only.

rounds.ai_message: Water-based on light colors and discharge on dark — works. About the print placement — chest center, 7 cm below neckline. Standard?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 浅色水浆深色拔染可以。印花位置——胸前居中领下 7 厘米。标准吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 印花位置 7-10 cm 是常规；位置对版影响大。
rounds.tips_zh: 印花位置 7-10 cm 是常见区间；要与纸样对齐。
rounds.user_response_example: Chest center, 7 cm below neckline. Standard. Please mark on the tech pack.

rounds.ai_message: Confirmed. About wash — after print and embroidery, you want enzyme wash at 30 minutes plus silicone softener. Any concerns with print cracking or embroidery shrinkage?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 确认。印花和绣花后做 30 分钟酵素水洗加硅油柔软。担心印花开裂或绣花缩吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: enzyme wash 30 分钟是常规；过长可能引起印花开裂。
rounds.tips_zh: enzyme wash 30 分钟 + 硅油是安全组合；45 分钟以上需测试。
rounds.user_response_example: Enzyme wash 30 minutes is safe for both print and embroidery. Silicone softener after wash is fine. Please run a 5-piece wash test before bulk.

rounds.ai_message: Hi Mark, Jack from Lily Embroidery. We received your inquiry for an 8 cm wide logo on 10,000 hoodies with chenille + satin stitch combo. Before I quote, can I see the artwork?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 嗨 Mark，我是 Lily 绣花 Jack。收到 10,000 件卫衣 8 厘米绳绣 + 缎面绣组合 logo 的询价。报价前能看到图稿吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: chenille（绳绣）+ satin（缎面）组合工艺报价要分项。
rounds.tips_zh: chenille 是立体绳绣，需专用针；与缎面组合报价要分开。
rounds.user_response_example: DST and AI files ready. Chenille base for the body, satin stitch for the outline, total 8 cm wide.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Chenille requires a special needle and a cap frame to hold the loops. It costs more than standard embroidery. Are you OK with the MOQ — 5,000 pieces minimum?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。绳绣需专用针和帽框固定环状效果。比普通绣花贵。MOQ 5,000 件可以接受吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 MOQ 与绳绣报价
rounds.common_mistakes: 绳绣 MOQ 通常 5,000 件；小批量工厂不愿接。
rounds.tips_zh: 绳绣换针换框成本高；MOQ 5,000 是行业惯例。
rounds.user_response_example: MOQ 5,000 is fine. The chenille premium is acceptable. Please quote per piece with stitch breakdown.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Digitizing for chenille + satin combo is US$45. Embroidery cost US$0.32 per piece with 8,000 stitches. Total US$3,245. Lead time 12 days for samples. Print — do you also want a discharge print on the back?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。绳绣 + 缎面打版 45 美元。8,000 针每件 0.32 美元，合计 3,245 美元。样衣 12 天。印花——后背还要拔染印花吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 后背大图与胸前绣花组合常见于街头潮牌。
rounds.tips_zh: 后背拔染印花 + 胸前立体绣花是潮牌经典组合。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, large back print with discharge ink on the dark color hoodies. Front embroidery on chest, back print 25 cm wide.

rounds.ai_message: Got it. For back print 25 cm wide, we can use rotary screen printing on dark ground. Discharge ink with white pigment. Cost US$0.55 per piece. Color registration within 0.3 mm.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。后背 25 厘米宽可圆网印花在深底上，用拔染白浆。每件 0.55 美元，套色 0.3 毫米以内。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认后背印花工艺与精度
rounds.common_mistakes: 圆网印花套色 0.3 mm 是常规；0.2 mm 需高精度设备。
rounds.tips_zh: 圆网印花套色 0.3 mm 是行业标准；0.2 mm 需要高精度设备。
rounds.user_response_example: Rotary screen is fine. 0.3 mm registration is acceptable for the back print. Please send a strike-off before bulk.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. About enzyme wash — this is a vintage style hoodie. Enzyme wash 45 minutes with pumice stone for hand feel. Will the chenille loops survive?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。酵素水洗——这款是复古卫衣。45 分钟酵素水洗加浮石做手感。绳绣环能承受吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明水洗与绳绣兼容性
rounds.common_mistakes: 绳绣长时间水洗 + 浮石容易散口；要测试。
rounds.tips_zh: 绳绣 45 分钟 + 浮石易散口；建议先打样测试。
rounds.user_response_example: Chenille loops may loosen with 45 minutes + pumice. Please run a 5-piece wash test first. If loops loosen, we can shorten to 30 minutes without pumice.

rounds.ai_message: Will test first. About color fastness — after enzyme wash, the print must reach grade 4 washing and 3-4 rubbing. Our standard soaping process should achieve this.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 会先测。色牢度——水洗后印花要达到水洗 4 级、耐摩擦 3-4 级。我方标准皂洗工艺应该能达到。
rounds.common_mistakes: discharge print 拔染印花的湿擦牢度容易偏低，要加强皂洗。
rounds.tips_zh: discharge print 湿擦牢度易偏低；皂洗 + 固色剂可改善。
rounds.user_response_example: Grade 4 washing and 3-4 rubbing are mandatory. Please add a cationic fixing agent after soaping to push wet rubbing to grade 4. Test report with each shipment.

rounds.ai_message: Cationic fixing agent accepted. About wash dimensional change — must stay within 3% both directions after 3 home washes. Our standard compactor should hold that.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 固色剂接受。水洗尺寸变化——3 次家庭洗后经纬向均在 3% 以内。标准压光可达到。
rounds.common_mistakes: 卫衣缩水控制比 T 恤难；要提前预缩 + 压光。
rounds.tips_zh: 卫衣克重厚，缩水难控制；要坯布预缩 + 成衣压光双管齐下。
rounds.user_response_example: 3% dimensional change is acceptable. Please add a compactor pass on all 10,000 hoodies. Test report after 3 home washes must be attached.

rounds.ai_message: Compactor pass added. Final cost: embroidery US$3,245, back print US$5,500, enzyme wash + compactor US$0.40 per piece = US$4,000. Total US$12,745. Lead time 35 days after PP sample approval. PI will be issued today.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 已加压光。最终成本：绣花 3,245 美元、后背印花 5,500 美元、酵素水洗 + 压光每件 0.4 美元共 4,000 美元。合计 12,745 美元。批 PP 样后 35 天交期。今天发 PI。
rounds.common_mistakes: PI 要核对每项工艺单价；不要只看总价。
rounds.tips_zh: 多工艺订单 PI 要拆分明细：绣花、印花、水洗单独报价便于管控。
rounds.user_response_example: PI received. The cost breakdown is clear and acceptable. We will counter-sign within 3 days and arrange 30% deposit by wire.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, Jack from Lily Embroidery. Before I quote this 20,000-piece order with chenille + discharge + enzyme wash, I need to flag a compliance risk — the EU buyer requires REACH SVHC below 0.1% for all inks and dyes. Our current discharge ink is at 0.08%, but the EU list grows every 6 months. Do you have a compliance buffer plan?
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，我是 Lily 绣花 Jack。报这 20,000 件绳绣 + 拔染 + 酵素水洗订单前要说明合规风险——欧盟客户要求所有油墨和染料 REACH SVHC 低于 0.1%。我方当前拔染浆是 0.08%，但欧盟清单每 6 个月更新。你有合规缓冲方案吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回应 REACH 合规与缓冲
rounds.common_mistakes: REACH SVHC 是动态清单；不能只说 'compliant'，要给具体数字。
rounds.tips_zh: REACH SVHC 清单动态更新；建议供应商定期测试并提供 SDS。
rounds.user_response_example: We REACH-test every batch and have buffer to 0.05% SVHC for all inks. We can also provide a 12-month SDS validity to cover your launch window.

rounds.ai_message: Good — 0.05% buffer and SDS validity. Now about the chenille embroidery — the EU buyer requires nickel-free needles and zippers per REACH. Our chenille machine uses nickel-plated needles. We would need to switch to nickel-free needles, which add US$0.02 per piece. OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好——0.05% 缓冲 + SDS 有效期。关于绳绣——欧盟客户要求 REACH 镍释放标准，针和拉链不能含镍。我方绳绣机用镀镍针，需换无镍针，每件加 0.02 美元。可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在镍释放合规与成本间权衡
rounds.common_mistakes: REACH 镍释放标准对金属部件是硬指标，不能用成本豁免。
rounds.tips_zh: REACH 镍释放对金属部件是硬合规；不可省。
rounds.user_response_example: Nickel-free needles are mandatory per REACH Annex XVII. The US$0.02 per piece premium is acceptable. Please attach the nickel-release test certificate with each shipment.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. About the discharge print — last season we had a complaint about color migration between the red discharge and white embroidery. The white embroidery yellowed after 2 weeks. We think it's the discharge residue reacting with the embroidery backing. Can we mitigate?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。拔染印花——上季红色拔染与白色绣花之间有色迁移投诉，白绣 2 周后发黄。怀疑拔染残留与绣花衬反应。能缓解吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: discharge print + 白色绣花的色迁移是工艺难题，要从衬和皂洗两端解决。
rounds.tips_zh: discharge 残留与绣花衬的色迁移，可用酸洗 + 充分皂洗缓解。
rounds.user_response_example: Please use acid-free tear-away backing for the white embroidery. Extend soaping to 60 minutes at 95°C. If that fails, we can move the embroidery to a non-adjacent location.

rounds.ai_message: Agreed. Acid-free backing + extended soaping. Now a capacity issue — the enzyme wash capacity at our laundry is 5,000 pieces per day. Your 20,000 pieces need 4 days washing plus 2 days drying. Total wash cycle 6 days. Can your buyer accept this in the lead time?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同意。无酸衬 + 延长皂洗。产能问题——我方洗水厂日产能 5,000 件。20,000 件需要 4 天水洗 + 2 天干燥，共 6 天。你客户能接受这交期吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在交期与洗衣产能之间权衡
rounds.common_mistakes: 洗衣厂产能是水洗订单的瓶颈；要早沟通。
rounds.tips_zh: 水洗厂日产能是水洗订单瓶颈；旺季要提前 2 周预约。
rounds.user_response_example: 6 days wash cycle is acceptable. Please add 1 day buffer for QC. Total wash + QC = 7 days. Can fit in our 35-day lead time.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Final pricing — embroidery US$3,800, back print US$11,000, enzyme wash + compactor US$8,000, REACH compliance + nickel-free needles US$400. Total US$23,200 for 20,000 pcs. US$1.16 per piece. FOB Ningbo. TT 30/70.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。最终价——绣花 3,800 美元、后背印花 11,000 美元、酵素水洗 + 压光 8,000 美元、REACH 合规 + 无镍针 400 美元。共 23,200 美元，20,000 件每件 1.16 美元，FOB 宁波，TT 30/70。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在总价与议价之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 多工艺订单要拆分明细核对，避免笼统总价。
rounds.tips_zh: 多工艺订单要逐项核对：绣花、印花、水洗、合规附加费。
rounds.user_response_example: Per piece US$1.16 is on the high side for the volume. Can you do US$1.08 if we commit to 15,000 pcs repeat in 6 months?

rounds.ai_message: US$1.08 is workable with a 15,000-piece repeat intent within 6 months. We'll need a signed side letter. Also — your last shipment had 2% dimensional change after enzyme wash, exceeding your 3% spec slightly. We have switched to a sanforizing pre-shrink on the greige fabric. Will that close it?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 1.08 美元可行，需 6 个月内 15,000 件翻单意向函，且签侧函。你上批酵素水洗后尺寸变化 2%，略超 3% 规格。已换坯布预缩。能解决吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: sanforizing 机械预缩比自然预缩更可控，是缩水问题的标准解决。
rounds.tips_zh: sanforizing（机械预缩）控制缩水率比自然预缩可靠。
rounds.user_response_example: Sanforizing pre-shrink on greige is the correct fix. Please attach the pre-shrunk test report with each shipment. Side letter for 15,000 pcs repeat is acceptable.

rounds.ai_message: Side letter and test report confirmed. One more concern — your buyer specifies OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class II for the finished garment. Our current chenille thread is not OEKO-TEX certified. We would need to source certified thread at US$0.01 per piece extra. OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 侧函与检测报告确认。还有一点——你客户要求成衣 OEKO-TEX 100 二类认证。我方当前绳绣线未认证。需换认证线，每件加 0.01 美元。可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在 OEKO-TEX 认证与成本间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: OEKO-TEX 100 是品牌客户常要求；要看是 Class I 还是 Class II。
rounds.tips_zh: OEKO-TEX 100 Class II 适用于直接接触皮肤产品；Class I 更严（婴儿）。
rounds.user_response_example: OEKO-TEX Class II is mandatory for our buyer. US$0.01 per piece is acceptable. Please attach the OEKO-TEX certificate with the first shipment.

rounds.ai_message: OEKO-TEX confirmed. Final terms: 20,000 pcs at US$1.08 per piece, OEKO-TEX thread + nickel-free needles, sanforizing pre-shrink, side letter for 15,000 pcs repeat. PI will be issued today. Please counter-sign within 4 days for our MD's approval.
rounds.ai_message_zh: OEKO-TEX 确认。最终条款：20,000 件每件 1.08 美元，OEKO-TEX 线 + 无镍针，预缩坯布，15,000 件翻单侧函。今天发 PI。请 4 天内回签以便总经理审批。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 PI 与 MD 审批时限
rounds.common_mistakes: 大单 PI 总经理审批 4 天是合理；不要承诺 1 天。
rounds.tips_zh: 大单 PI 需要内部多部门审批；预留 4-5 天是合理的。
rounds.user_response_example: PI received. 4 days MD approval is realistic given the compliance and repeat terms. I will counter-sign by Friday and arrange deposit the same day.
